name: 18-session-closed-now
why: XAUUSD (METALS) with a configured trading session only on another weekday, so the market is closed now; the tick is fresh and would stop the account out. A closed session means no usable price on both engines.

knownDivergence.note: Until Stage 2 F2 the engine still counts a position without a usable price in used margin (at its open price), which also puts it in margin call; the web counts it nowhere. The close decision already matches (F4).
